new_jobs.title: Business Development Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Location:** **Taiwan (Hsinchu / Taipei / Taichung)** **Territory:** **Taiwan, Japan, Mainland China** **Reports to:** **Head of Business Development / VP Sales & Marketing** **Employment:** **Full-time, permanent** **Travel:** **Approx. 40–50 %, predominantly within the region** **THE ROLE** Glass is moving from a niche carrier material to a core building block of advanced packaging. Glass core substrates, glass interposers, through-glass vias (TGV) and glass panels for fan-out are being qualified across the industry right now — and the decisions that will define the supply chain for the next decade are being made in Taiwan, Japan and Mainland China. This is deliberately **not an operational sales role** . It is not about quotations, order processing or hitting a short-term revenue quota. We are looking for someone who understands where glass-based packaging is heading technically and commercially, who can read the roadmaps of substrate makers, OSATs and foundries, and who translates that understanding into concrete business opportunities on a 12- to 36-month horizon. The role sits at the interface between the market and the company: feeding technical market intelligence into our product and technology strategy, while opening doors to the decision-makers who matter across the regional glass and packaging ecosystem. **RESPONSIBILITIES** **I. Market Development:** • Identify and assess new applications, customer segments and business models for glass in advanced packaging — glass core substrates, interposers, TGV-based structures, glass carriers, panel-level processing and photonic/optical integration • Develop market entry and growth strategies for Taiwan, Japan and Mainland China, accounting for the distinct dynamics of each market • Build and qualify a pipeline of strategic opportunities; hand off qualified projects to sales and application engineering • Prepare business cases, feasibility assessments and management decision papers **II. Market Intelligence and Technology Scouting:** • Track technology developments across the glass value chain: TGV formation and laser processing, metallization and RDL on glass, warpage and CTE management, thin-glass handling, hybrid bonding on glass, panel-level formats (510 × 515 mm and beyond) • Monitor how glass competes with and complements organic substrates, silicon interposers and ABF build-up technology — including the cost-per-area and yield arguments that will decide adoption • Analyse competitor and capacity movements: qualification announcements, capex, new lines at substrate makers and OSATs, joint ventures and M&A • Assess regulatory and geopolitical conditions — export controls, localisation requirements, national funding programmes — and their impact on the regional supply chain • Deliver structured market reports and roadmap reviews to executive management, product management and R&D **III. Partner and Key Account Network:** • Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers and senior technologists at substrate manufacturers, OSATs, foundries, IDMs, panel and PCB makers, and equipment suppliers across the region • Develop joint development agreements, co-qualification programmes and ecosystem partnerships — glass adoption is a multi-party effort and depends on aligning several players at once • Engage with research institutes, consortia and industry bodies in the region (ITRI, AIST, university clusters, SEMI working groups on glass substrates and panel-level packaging) • Represent the company at leading trade shows and technical conferences (SEMICON Taiwan / Japan / China, ECTC, IMAPS, IWLPC, IEDM) **IV. Internal Collaboration:** • Work closely with product management, R&D and application engineering to feed market requirements back into the technology roadmap • Support regional sales teams with market knowledge, customer access and strategic context • Collaborate with business development counterparts in Europe and North America **YOUR PROFILE** **A. Required:** • Degree in materials science, electrical engineering, physics, semiconductor or mechanical engineering, or a comparable field; MBA an advantage • Minimum 7 years in the semiconductor or electronic materials industry, with several years directly related to advanced packaging, substrates or assembly & test • Solid technical grasp of packaging processes, materials and equipment, and of the associated value chain and cost structures; hands-on familiarity with glass, substrate or interposer technology is a strong plus • Demonstrable, active network within the East Asian packaging and substrate value chain • Resident in Taiwan, or clear willingness and eligibility to relocate and be based there permanently • Business-fluent Mandarin and English • Proven experience working across borders, particularly with Japanese and Chinese business partners **B. Preferred:** • Japanese language skills — at minimum conversational, ideally business level • Background in a strategic function: business development, corporate strategy, technical marketing or product management • Experience bridging a Western company with regional responsibility in Asia, or the reverse • Familiarity with market data sources such as Yole, TechInsights or TrendForce **C. Personal Attributes:** • Strategic perspective combined with the ability to engage credibly on technical detail • Independent, structured and self-driven — this role runs on initiative rather than direction • Cultural fluency and diplomatic judgement, particularly across the Taiwan–Japan–China triangle • Persuasive at C-level and with development engineers alike **WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT:** For clarity, the following are **not** part of this position: • Ownership of a short-term revenue or bookings quota • Day-to-day operational work: quotations, price negotiations, order processing, forecasting • Management of existing account business • Line management of a sales team Performance is measured against strategic outcomes: the quality and maturity of opportunities developed, the strength of partnerships established, and the relevance and impact of market intelligence on company strategy. **WHAT WE OFFER:** • Real influence in one of the most consequential material transitions in semiconductor packaging • Direct visibility and short reporting lines to executive management • Competitive package with a strategy-linked variable component • Flexible working arrangements with a regional base in Taiwan

new_jobs.title: Silicon Design Engineer
new_jobs.jd: **ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.** At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. **The Role** We are looking for a hands-on **automation** engineer to drive the development and deployment of next-generation packaging design automation and AI-driven workflows. You will focus on accelerating the design of advanced heterogeneous integration technologies—specifically substrates, organic interposers, and bridge interconnects. AMD's environment is fast-paced, results-oriented, and built upon a legion of innovators with a passion for winning technology. **The Person** The successful candidate is a hands-on technical contributor who can bridge the gap between physical design requirements and software automation to build AI-driven workflows. He or she must have a drive for solutions and an aptitude to thrive in a multi-tasking environment, translating complex design challenges into scriptable, scalable workflows. They should possess good cross-functional collaboration skills to work across Design, EDA, and AI teams, with clear technical communication and documentation skills. Able to work effectively with minimal supervision and motivated to grow along the technical ladder. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, deploy, and maintain AI workflows for Substrate, Interposer, and Silicon Bridge design methodologies. * Apply AI/ML methodologies to optimize critical design stages, including auto-routing, component placement, and signal integrity optimization. * Work with EDA vendors and internal stakeholders to evaluate and implement next-generation features for 2.5D and 3D packaging. * Contribute to the transition from manual design practices to "Agentic" and algorithmic design workflows. * Collaborate with electrical and mechanical analysis teams to build closed-loop optimization systems that feed simulation results back into design construction. * Document and report automation efficiency gains, ROI, and tool-capability improvements. * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support critical design tape-outs and methodology milestones. * Share coding best practices and packaging knowledge with peers. **Preferred Experience** * Strong knowledge of EDA packaging design tools (Cadence APD/SiP, Siemens Xpedition, or Synopsys 3DIC/Compiler). * Hands-on track record of developing automation using Python, Tcl, SKILL, or C++. * Experience applying AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.) to engineering or design problems. * Familiarity with advanced packaging architectures (2.5D/3D, Chiplets, Fan-Out, Hybrid Bonding). * Familiarity with design verification flows (DRC/LVS) and electrical extraction concepts. * Experience automating Cadence Allegro package databases (SKILL) and/or SI/PI data workflows (e.g., PowerSI) is a plus. * Good teamwork and interpersonal skills. **Academic Credentials** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with relevant packaging or CAD-automation experience. *Benefits offered are described:* AMD benefits at a glance. *AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.* *AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD’s “Responsible AI Policy” is available here.* *This posting is for an existing vacancy.*
